title: Chapter 7
text: 52. EXT. SATURN - DAY The Endurance settles into an orbit around the ringed giant. TOM (O.S.) But they said I can start advanced agriculture a year early ... INT. COMMUNICATIONS BOOTH, ENDURANCE - CONTINUOUS Cooper, blanket around his shoulders, watches a highly compressed video of Tom - TOM Got to go, Dad. Hope you’re safe up there. Tom makes way for Donald: DONALD I’m sorry, Coop, I asked Murph to say hi, but she’s stubborn as her old man. I’ll try again next time, stay safe. The video cuts out. Cooper gets up, puts a pair of EAR BUDS in his ears and heads into -
